inclusion_criteria: ECOG performance status ≤ 1.

Must have histologically or cytologically confirmed progressive advanced/metastatic HER2-positive breast carcinoma as per the updated American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) - College of American Pathologists (CAP) guidelines according to local testing.
HER2 status may be determined in the primary breast cancer tumour or, when not available, in a metastatic lesion.
Multifocal unilateral or bilateral breast adenocarcinoma tumours are allowed if all tested HER2-positive, according to local testing.
Prior treatment with taxane, trastuzumab and pertuzumab (early or advanced setting) and T-DXd (metastatic setting).
In order to be eligible, patients subjects must have received T-DXd as the last systemic metastatic treatment line before inclusion.
Patients subjects must have presented disease progression on T-DXd.
Prior therapy with tucatinib, trastuzumab, and capecitabine, in advanced setting, is permissible, provided that T-DXd serves as the last systemic metastatic treatment line before inclusion.
Patient subject must have presented disease progression on T-DXd when prior tucatinib, trastuzumab, and capecitabine were administered.
Life expectancy ≥ 6 months.
At screening FDG-PET at least two 'target' lesions are required.
Target lesions must have anatomically transaxial diameter ≥ 1.5 cm.

Target lesions must be metabolically assessable with a maximum standard uptake value corrected for lean body mass (SUVmax) ≥ 1.5 x SUVmean + 2 standard deviations (SD) of the liver measured in a 3-cm-diameter spherical volume of interest (VOI) in normal liver parenchyma.
In case of suspected liver metastasis, a lesion should have a SUVmax ≥ 2 x SUVmean + 3 SD of the blood pool measured in a 1 cm-diameter VOI within descending thoracic aorta.
Lesions pre-treated with irradiation are not eligible for consideration as 'target' lesions.
Absolute Neutrophil Count (ANC) ≥1000/μL or ≥1x109/L.
Platelets ≥100,000/μL or ≥ 100 x 109/L.
Haemoglobin ≥ 9 g/dL.
Serum creatinine ≤ 1.5 x upper limit of normal (ULN).
Estimated creatinine clearance ≥ 60 ml/min as calculated using the method standard for the institution.
Total serum bilirubin ≤ 1.5 x ULN unless the patient subject has documented Gilbert syndrome.
Aspartate Aminotransferase (AST) ≤ 2.5x ULN.
Alanine Aminotransferase (ALT) ≤ 2.5x ULN.
Current left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≥ 50% on echocardiography or multiple-gated acquisition scanning.
No history of a LVEF < 40%.
No history of symptomatic heart failure.
No recent myocardial infarction.
Willingness to provide tumour tissue (mandatory biopsy) for translational research activities.
Willingness to provide blood samples (mandatory) for translational research activities.
Willingness to comply with the protocol for the duration of the study including treatment and scheduled visits and examinations.
Signed Informed Consent form (ICF) obtained prior to any study related procedure.
Affiliated to the French Social Security System.
exclusion_criteria: Prior exposure to T-DM1 for the treatment of metastatic BC.
For subjects exposed to T-DM1 for the treatment of early BC, relapse while on or within 12 months of finishing treatment with T-DM1.
Brain metastasis as sole metastasis.
Symptomatic brain metastasis.
Brain metastasis requiring therapy to control symptoms.
History of interstitial lung disease / pneumonitis (grade 3 or 4) during the prior treatment with T-DXd.
Significant symptoms (Grade ≥ 2) relating to LV dysfunction while or since receiving preoperative therapy.
Significant symptoms (Grade ≥ 2) relating to cardiac arrhythmia while or since receiving preoperative therapy.
Significant symptoms (Grade ≥ 2) relating to cardiac ischemia while or since receiving preoperative therapy.
Uncontrolled hypertension (systolic blood pressure > 180 mmHg and/or diastolic blood pressure > 100 mmHg).
Inadequately controlled angina.
Serious cardiac arrhythmia not controlled by adequate medication.
Severe conduction abnormality.
Clinically significant valvular disease.
Screening LVEF < 50% by either ECHO or MUGA.
History of NCI CTCAE (Version 4.0) Grade ≥ 3 symptomatic congestive heart failure (CHF).
New York Heart Association (NYHA) criteria Class ≥ II.
History of a decrease in LVEF to < 40% with prior trastuzumab treatment.
History of symptomatic CHF with prior trastuzumab treatment.
Myocardial infarction within 12 months prior to randomization.
Requirement for continuous oxygen therapy.
Known prior severe hypersensitivity to investigational product or any component in its formulations.
Known severe hypersensitivity reactions to trastuzumab or excipients.
Contra-indication for treatment with T-DM1.
Progressive disease within the first 6 months of T-DXd therapy after the cap of 10% rapid progressors has been reached.
Any known liver disease.
Known carriers of hepatitis B virus.
Known carriers of hepatitis C.
Autoimmune hepatic disorders.
Sclerosing cholangitis.
Concurrent serious uncontrolled infections.
Known infection with HIV.
Prior history of other invasive cancer in the past 5 years except basal cell carcinoma of skin that has been definitively treated.
Prior history of other invasive cancer in the past 5 years except squamous cell carcinoma of skin that has been definitively treated.
Pregnant women.
Lactating women.
Intending to become pregnant during the study.
Positive serum pregnancy test within 15 days prior to enrolment (for subjects of childbearing potential).

Women of childbearing potential refusing to use one highly effective method of contraception from ICF signature, during the course of the study and at least 7 months after the last administration of T-DM1.
Men with childbearing potential partner refusing to use condom during the course of this study and for at least 7 months after the last administration of T-DM1.
Significant medical condition currently uncontrolled by treatment that may interfere with completion of the study.
Significant neuro-psychiatric condition currently uncontrolled by treatment that may interfere with completion of the study.
Significant surgical condition currently uncontrolled by treatment that may interfere with completion of the study.
Vulnerable persons according to the article L.1121-6 of the Public Health Code.
Adults who are the subject of a measure of legal protection or unable to express their consent according to article L.1121-8 of the Public Health Code.
